name: Rocket Lab Electron
notes: Dedicated small launcher. Cheap, but it cannot lift a large spacecraft or reach beyond low Earth orbit.

name: Falcon 9
notes: The workhorse. Enough capacity for almost any design, at a price that eats a small mission's budget.

name: Atlas V 401
notes: Highest reliability on the board. You pay for that reliability twice over.

name: Falcon 9 Rideshare Slot
notes: You share a ride and take the orbit you are given. Extraordinarily cheap if your mission fits the box.
